svg.title: How each benchmark scores an answer
svg.desc: A walk ends on a set of entities. MetaQA's Hits@1 is the share of that set that is right. WebQSP's F1 combines precision and recall against the right answers. CWQ's P@1 is like Hits@1, and other known names of a right answer count too.
svg.text: How each benchmark scores an answer
A walk ends on a set of entities. Each benchmark compares that set with the right answers in its own way.
